create_tokenizer_subclass: create a subclass of Tokenizer that implements encode and decode methods for trajectory tokenization
encode_trajectories_with_manager: encode a dictionary of trajectory tensors using TokenizerManager to get tokenized outputs
decode_tokenized_trajectories: decode a dictionary of tokenized trajectory tensors back to original form using TokenizerManager
register_tokenizers_in_manager: build a TokenizerManager with a dict of named Tokenizer instances for batch encoding and decoding
implement_tokenizer_create_factory: implement the abstract create classmethod on a Tokenizer subclass to instantiate from a dataset
